name: materi
description: Materi tab (DECISIONS #36/#37): the tenant's materi library + THE canonical materi permalink. Server-rendered etalase header/metadata/OG from publicGetBySlug, member-gated body through MarkdownView, tag row + 'Muncul di kelas' backlinks below it. Read-only slice; materi writes stay in the Kelola console.
notes: 0.1.0 (2026-08-10, materi-model wave): the frontend half of convex/features/materi — that feature was landed by the convex wave and is NOT modified here. SSR contract: only publicGetBySlug (anonymous etalase whitelist) is read server-side, through safeQuery; it answers null for a DRAFT materi, so the page must NOT notFound() on null — the island renders its own <h1> instead (`hasServerHeading={false}`) and an instructor still gets the page. No function prop crosses the server→client boundary: the views take `tenantSlug` as a string and build every href from lib/hrefs.ts (that mistake has taken this app down twice). getBySlug THROWS NOT_FOUND for unknown/deleted/draft-below-instructor, and convex/react rethrows during render, so the detail view wraps its content in a local <MateriErrorBoundary resetKey={lessonSlug}> — otherwise a mistyped slug lands on app/error.tsx with no community chrome. lib/inset.ts restates the class strings of app/k/[slug]/_components/inset-list.tsx because a slice may not import the app layer (rr P1); the barrel test pins radius-0, the 3px hard shadow and the 56px row floor so drift is visible. Library search narrows the LOADED pages only — /cari is the indexed search, this is a filter.
